dct_title_s: Preliminary satellite-derived flood assessment -Bardere City, Baardheere District, Gedo Region, Somalia
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code FL20231105SOM** Status: Increased water extent along the Jubba River Further action(s): continue monitoring Summary of findings: - Increase of water extent along the Jubba River observed as of 12 November 2023; - Affected structures and agricultural areas. We also observe inundated roads in Bardere City, in the Gedo Region as of 12 November 2023;
